# Ilia Dzhiubanskii projects wiki

Purpose: public-safe technical memory for a portfolio chat.
Canonical routing page: index.md
Technology reverse index: technologies.md
Project pages: projects/*.md

Retrieval rules:
- Match project names and front-matter aliases.
- Prefer one project page; retrieve up to three for comparisons.
- Keep the overview and technology inventory in the same context window.
- Do not infer employers, customers, revenue, adoption, or proficiency beyond the text.
- Do not expose source paths, credentials, private infrastructure, or operational secrets.
- Distinguish products, internal systems, libraries, experiments, and learning curricula.
